summary: Lufax Holding (NYSE: LU; HKEX: 6623) filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong announcement of a connected transaction: an amendment extending the maturity of its Ping An Overseas Holdings convertible promissory notes by one year, from October 8, 2026 to October 8, 2027, for consideration of US$29,377,672.86 paid to Ping An Overseas Holdings. Outstanding principal is US$507,988,000 versus an appraised fair value of roughly US$478,610,000. Lufax will also redeem all US$468,912,000 of An Ke Technology notes at original maturity. An Ke and Ping An hold approximately 44.13% and 22.72%, so independent shareholder and Stock Exchange approvals are required; an EGM record date is set. Watch circular timing and minority-vote outcome.
